meta.hero_eyebrow: Research Trip · Suites With Keith / Fora
meta.hero_line: Working plan for the Italy collection, releasing print and digital February / March 2027

meta.hello: Twenty four nights, eight regions, one rental car until Verona. Who, where, when, and what is still open.

essentials.title: Flights
essentials.text: Out: BA0186 Austin to Heathrow, September 21, 10:30 PM, lands 1:55 PM. BA0522 Heathrow to Florence 7:05 PM, lands 10:20 PM. Two bags at 32 kg. Home: October 16 on points, details to come.

essentials.title: Rental car
essentials.text: Avis #26405920US2. Fiat 600, automatic. Pick up Florence airport September 25, move to 12:00. Drop Fiumicino, move to October 11 around noon. Prepaid.

essentials.title: Drive times
essentials.text: Chianti to the coast about 3 hours. Coast to Cernobbio 2 hours 15. Como to the Dolomites 5 hours 30 by motorway, 6 hours 15 over the Engadin. Alpina to Verona 2 hours 15, car back there, then trains to Venice and Rome.

essentials.title: Pace
essentials.text: No departures before 11:00 unless you choose. One visit a day is the target, two the ceiling.
